atlas.format: PNG/WebP alpha or SVG source; sRGB color + alpha
atlas.padding_rule: minimum 8px at 1K between opaque content and cell edge; duplicate edge pixels when rasterized to avoid mip bleed
atlas.mipmap_rule: generate mipmaps; clamp decal UV to cell with half-texel inset at runtime

uv_formula: col=index%4; row=floor(index/4); u0=col*0.25; v0=row*0.2; u1=u0+0.25; v1=v0+0.2

damage_overlay.rule: keep pristine semantic text atlas reusable; apply damage with separate shared masks so the same wording is not duplicated into multiple damaged textures

zone_mapping.A: heavy burn/soot/peeled paint, readability may be intentionally partial

runtime.material: transparent decal plane or projected decal; avoid adding thickness unless silhouette/contact requires it
runtime.alpha_test: prefer alphaTest for hard-edged signage on low-end devices; alphaBlend only when soft damage edge is needed
runtime.normal_ao: do not create per-sign Normal/AO; use one optional shared raised-paint/wear map

text_integrity.acceptance: Every canonical word must exactly match the cells list; garbled or misspelled AI text is rejected even when visual style is useful

qa.adobe_reference_text_visual_qa: FAIL_AS_TEXT_DONOR / PASS_STYLE_REFERENCE: HANGAR→HENIGAR, LANDING ZONE→LANDING JONE, duplicated/merged/missing labels detected; canonical text remains deterministic JSON+SVG
